name: Facebook Live

maxWidth.note: Live Video API reference, Video Format: "Resolution: 1920x1080" (1080p maximum).

portrait.note: "Pixel Aspect Ratio: Aim for 16:9". The facebook sink is fed from the H canvas (user 2026-11-27).

maxFps.note: Bitrate table tops out at 1080p @ 60 FPS.

videoCodecs.note: "H.264, Level 4.1 for up to 1080p 30 FPS", "H.264, Level 4.2 for 1080p 60 FPS".

min.note: 1080p @ 60 FPS: 4,500-9,000 Kbps (lower tiers for lower sizes: 1080p30 3,000-6,000; 720p60 2,250-6,000). The minimum is for 1080p60, the size the facebook sink uses; a warning, as the page gives ranges, not a refusal.

max.note: 1080p @ 60 FPS upper bound. The shared Twitch/Kick rung (1080p60 6000 kbps CBR) is inside it, so Facebook reuses that rung.
"Recommended 2 seconds. Do not exceed 4 seconds." Severity error because: the page says "Do not exceed 4 seconds."

protocols.note: "RTMPS Streaming"; the live_videos answer gives secure_stream_url (rtmps), which is the only one Ujwalam uses.

multitrackVideo.note: Not documented for the Live Video API.

max.note: "128 kbps (preferred) to 256 kbps (do not exceed)". Severity error because: the page says "256 kbps (do not exceed)".

recommended.note: Preferred 128 kbps. Ujwalam encodes audio once (the shared track), so a different shared bitrate is reported, not changed.
"44.1kHz or 48kHz": the shared 48 kHz track fits.

rateControl.note: Not stated; CBR is what Ujwalam's stream rungs use.

maxDurationSec.note: "Not exceed 8 hours". Not enforced by Ujwalam.

replyMaxChars.note: Ujwalam posts no Facebook live comments.

ingest.note: POST /{page-id}/live_videos (status LIVE_NOW) returns secure_stream_url for each broadcast; Ujwalam splits it into the server address and the key and keeps both in Windows Credential Manager (Ujwalam/stream/facebook-server, Ujwalam/stream/facebook) for that broadcast only; they are deleted when the stream ends. Page needs at least 100 followers and an account at least 60 days old (Meta, from 2024-06-10; error 1363144 / 1363120).

notes: Facebook Live to a Facebook Page (docs/plan/2026-11-27-facebook-live-ig-live-x-posting.md section 1). Page access token with pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement (Live Video API streaming guide, Broadcast on a Page; checked 2026-11-27).
